## Tutors Codebase: Route and Component Architecture

### 1. Complete Route Tree

The app uses SvelteKit route groups (parenthesized directories) to organize routes into four top-level groups:

```
src/routes/
  +layout.svelte                          -- Root layout (imports app.css, inits themes, auth reconnect)
  +layout.server.ts                       -- Root server layout (loads auth session)

  (home)/                                 -- Landing page group
    +layout.svelte                        -- Wraps in TutorsShell, sets currentCourse = null
    +page.svelte                          -- Home page (Welcome, TutorsInfo, Links, CourseList)
    +page.ts                              -- SSR disabled, no-op loader

  (auth)/                                 -- Authentication group
    auth/
      +page.svelte                        -- GitHub sign-in (redirect to "/")
      [courseid]/
        +page.svelte                      -- GitHub sign-in (redirect to "/course/{courseId}")
        +page.ts                          -- Passes courseId through

  (course-reader)/                        -- Main content group (all course-related routes)
    +layout.svelte                        -- Shared layout: TutorsShell wrapper, event tracking, breadcrumb scroll

    course/[courseid]/                    -- /course/:courseid
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readCourse()
      +page.svelte                        -- Renders <Composite>

    topic/[courseid]/[...loid]/           -- /topic/:courseid/*
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readTopic()
      +page.svelte                        -- Renders <Composite>

    talk/[courseid]/[...loid]/            -- /talk/:courseid/*
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readLo()
      +page.svelte                        -- <Context> + <TalkClient>

    paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]/       -- /paneltalk/:courseid/*
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readLo()
      +page.svelte                        -- <Context> + <TalkClient>

    note/[courseid]/[...loid]/            -- /note/:courseid/*
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readLo()
      +page.svelte                        -- <Context> + <Note>

    tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]/        -- /tutorial/:courseid/*
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readLo()
      +page.svelte                        -- <Context> + <Note> + optional <TalkClient> (if PDF)

    lab/[courseid]/[...loid]/             -- /lab/:courseid/*
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readLab() -> LiveLab
      +page.svelte                        -- <Context> + <Lab> (or <TalkClient> if PDF)

    video/[courseid]/[...loid]/           -- /video/:courseid/*
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readLo() (handles query params for start/end)
      +page.svelte                        -- <Context> + <Video>

    wall/[type]/[courseid]/               -- /wall/:type/:courseid
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readWall()
      +page.svelte                        -- <Wall>

    search/[courseid]/                    -- /search/:courseid
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readCourse()
      +page.svelte                        -- Full-text search across labs, steps, notes

    llm/[courseid]/                       -- /llm/:courseid
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readCourse() + generateLlms()
      +page.svelte                        -- Renders LLM-friendly docs links (llms.txt convention)

    time/[courseid]/                      -- /time/:courseid
      +page.ts                            -- courseService.readCourse()
      +page.svelte                        -- Student calendar heatmaps and tables

  (live)/                                 -- Live/presence group
    +layout.svelte                        -- TutorsShell wrapper, loads catalogue stats
    catalogue/
      +page.ts                            -- catalogueService.getCatalogue()
      +page.svelte                        -- Shows catalogue of courses with visit counts
    live/
      +page.svelte                        -- Global live view (Courses, Students, Groups tabs)
      [courseid]/
        +page.ts                          -- courseService.readCourse()
        +page.svelte                      -- Per-course live activity (online now, day/week/month/year)
```

### 2. How Content Types Load Data and Render

Every content route follows one of two patterns:

**Pattern A -- "Leaf content" (talk, note, video, paneltalk, tutorial):**
1. `+page.ts` calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)` which fetches the course JSON, indexes all learning objects by route, and returns the matching `Lo`.
2. `+page.svelte` wraps the content in `<Context lo={data.lo}>` (provides secondary navigation + a side panel with table-of-contents) and renders a type-specific component inside.

**Pattern B -- "Composite/structural" (course, topic):**
1. `+page.ts` calls `courseService.readCourse()` or `courseService.readTopic()`.
2. `+page.svelte` renders `<Composite composite={data.course}>` or `<Composite composite={data.topic}>` which handles panels, units, and cards.

**Pattern C -- "Lab" (special):**
1. `+page.ts` calls `courseService.readLab()` which creates a `LiveLab` instance with chapter navigation state, markdown-to-HTML conversion, and step tracking.
2. `+page.svelte` renders `<Lab lab={data.lab}>` with sidebar chapter navigation and keyboard arrow-key support.

### 3. Shared Layout Architecture

**Root layout** (`D:/code/tutors/src/routes/+layout.svelte`): Minimal -- imports `app.css`, initializes theme display, and handles auth reconnection. Renders `{@render children()}`.

**Root server layout** (`D:/code/tutors/src/routes/+layout.server.ts`): Loads auth session from `locals.auth()` and passes `loggedIn` and `user` to all pages.

**Course-reader layout** (`D:/code/tutors/src/routes/(course-reader)/+layout.svelte`): The core shared layout for all course content. It:
- Wraps everything in `<CourseShell>` (imported as `TutorsShell.svelte`)
- Starts the connect service timer
- Tracks learning events via `$effect` on page params
- Checks whitelist and logs course visits
- After navigation, auto-scrolls to `#content-panel`
- Sets the page `<title>` to the current course title

**TutorsShell** (`D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/TutorsShell.svelte`): Provides the full page scaffold:
- Sticky header with `<MainNavigator>` (AppBar with course title, search, layout menu, profile, ToC button)
- Flex main area for content
- Footer (visible only on tall screens)

### 4. Component Library

All UI components live under `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/`. Here is the taxonomy:

**Content renderers** (`src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/`):
| Component | File | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `TalkClient.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/TalkClient.svelte` | PDF viewer -- dispatches to TalkAdobe (default) or TalkMozilla based on course config |
| `TalkAdobe.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/TalkAdobe.svelte` | Adobe PDF embed |
| `TalkMozilla.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/TalkMozilla.svelte` | Mozilla PDF.js viewer (lazy-loaded) |
| `Note.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Note.svelte` | Renders markdown-to-HTML (`lo.contentHtml`) with prose styling and KaTeX support. Hides MainNavigator. |
| `Video.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Video.svelte` | Iframe-based video player (supports heanet, vimp, and generic services) |
| `Lab.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Lab.svelte` | Multi-step lab with sidebar chapter nav, keyboard navigation, and horizontal mobile nav |
| `Calendar.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Calendar.svelte` | Calendar view |
| `Podcast.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Podcast.svelte` | Podcast player |

**Layout components** (`src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/`):
| Component | File | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Panels.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/Panels.svelte` | Renders panel-level content: panelPodcasts, panelVideos, panelTalks, panelNotes inline |
| `Units.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/Units.svelte` | Renders a list of Composite units, each with title, image, panels, and cards |
| `Cards.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/Cards.svelte` | Grid of Card components for standard learning objects |
| `Card.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/Card.svelte` | Individual card with portrait/landscape/circular variants, themed by content type |
| `Wall.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/Wall.svelte` | "Wall" view showing all LOs of a given type across a course (cards for non-video, inline players for video/podcast) |
| `LoContextPanel.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/LoContextPanel.svelte` | Sidebar context card (shows image, title, and tree nav for current topic/course context) |

**Structure components** (`src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/`):
| Component | File | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Context.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/Context.svelte` | Wrapper for leaf content. Adds SecondaryNavigator + optional LoContextPanel sidebar (visible on XL screens). Walks up the LO tree to find the parent topic/course. |
| `Composite.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/Composite.svelte` | Renders a composite LO (course or topic): SecondaryNavigator + Panels + Units + Cards, with optional side units |
| `LoContext.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/LoContext.svelte` | Individual LO context entry |
| `LoContextTree.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/LoContextTree.svelte` | Tree navigation in context panel |
| `CourseContext.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/CourseContext.svelte` | Course-level context |
| `LoReference.svelte` | `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/LoReference.svelte` | LO reference display |

**Navigator components** (`src/lib/ui/navigators/`):
- `MainNavigator.svelte` -- Top AppBar (course title, search, layout menu, LLM indicator, time indicator, profile, ToC)
- `SecondaryNavigator.svelte` -- Breadcrumbs bar + icon bars for companions and walls
- `Breadcrumbs.svelte`, `SearchButton.svelte`, `TocButton.svelte`, `InfoButton.svelte`, `LayoutMenu.svelte`, etc.

### 5. End-to-End Trace: How a "Talk" is Rendered

Here is the complete flow for navigating to a URL like `/talk/my-course/topic-1/my-talk`:

**Step 1 -- Route matching and data loading:**
- SvelteKit matches `src/routes/(course-reader)/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]/+page.ts`
- `params.courseid` = `"my-course"`, `url.pathname` = `"/talk/my-course/topic-1/my-talk"`
- The loader calls `courseService.readLo("my-course", "/talk/my-course/topic-1/my-talk", fetch)`

**Step 2 -- courseService.readLo()** (file: `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/services/course/services/course.svelte.ts`, line 132):
- Calls `this.readCourse("my-course", fetch)` which:
  - Checks the course cache (`this.courses` Map)
  - If not cached, calls `determineCourseUrl()` to resolve the courseId to a URL (e.g., `my-course.netlify.app`)
  - Fetches `https://my-course.netlify.app/tutors.json`
  - Calls `decorateCourseTree()` which recursively processes all LOs: sets parent references, builds breadcrumbs, converts markdown to HTML, creates panels/units, indexes everything into `course.loIndex` and `course.topicIndex`
  - Sets `currentCourse` and `currentLo` runes
- Looks up the LO by route in `course.loIndex.get("/talk/my-course/topic-1/my-talk")`
- Sets `currentLo.value = lo`
- Returns `{ lo }` to the page

**Step 3 -- Layout rendering:**
- The `(course-reader)/+layout.svelte` wraps everything in `<TutorsShell>`:
  - `<MainNavigator>` renders at top (AppBar with course title, search, etc.)
  - `<Footer>` renders at bottom
- The layout also fires `tutorsConnectService.learningEvent(page.params)` for analytics

**Step 4 -- Page rendering** (`D:/code/tutors/src/routes/(course-reader)/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]/+page.svelte`):
```svelte
<Context lo={data.lo}>
  <TalkClient lo={data.lo} />
</Context>
```

**Step 5 -- Context.svelte** (`D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/Context.svelte`):
- Walks up `lo.parentLo` until it finds a `type === "topic"` or `type === "course"` to establish the `loContext`
- Renders `<SecondaryNavigator>` (breadcrumbs + companion icons + wall icons)
- Renders children (the TalkClient) in a flex container
- On XL screens, shows `<LoContextPanel>` sidebar on the right with an image and tree navigation for sibling content

**Step 6 -- TalkClient.svelte** (`D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/TalkClient.svelte`):
- Checks `currentCourse.value.defaultPdfReader`
- If `"mozilla"`: dynamically imports and renders `<TalkMozilla>` (PDF.js viewer)
- Otherwise: renders `<TalkAdobe>` (Adobe PDF embed)
- The `lo.pdf` field contains the full URL to the PDF file (injected during `decorateCourseTree` via `injectCourseUrl()`)

### Summary of the Content Type Rendering Patterns

| Content Type | Route Pattern | Data Loader | Page Structure | Render Component |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **course** | `/course/[courseid]` | `readCourse()` | `<Composite>` | Panels + Units + Cards |
| **topic** | `/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readTopic()` | `<Composite>` | Panels + Units + Cards |
| **talk** | `/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLo()` | `<Context>` + child | `<TalkClient>` (PDF) |
| **paneltalk** | `/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLo()` | `<Context>` + child | `<TalkClient>` (PDF) |
| **note** | `/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLo()` | `<Context>` + child | `<Note>` (HTML from markdown) |
| **tutorial** | `/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLo()` | `<Context>` + child | `<Note>` + optional `<TalkClient>` |
| **lab** | `/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLab()` | `<Context>` + child | `<Lab>` (multi-step) or `<TalkClient>` |
| **video** | `/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLo()` | `<Context>` + child | `<Video>` (iframe) |
| **wall** | `/wall/[type]/[courseid]` | `readWall()` | standalone | `<Wall>` (grid of cards or videos) |

**To add a new content type (e.g., "notebook")**, the pattern would be:
1. Create route directory `src/routes/(course-reader)/notebook/[courseid]/[...loid]/`
2. Add `+page.ts` calling `courseService.readLo()` (same as talk/note/video)
3. Add `+page.svelte` wrapping a new `<Notebook>` component in `<Context>`
4. Create `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Notebook.svelte` with the rendering logic
5. Ensure the `@tutors/tutors-model-lib` model includes the "notebook" type in its Lo types and that the course JSON includes notebook LOs with appropriate routes

### 2. How Content Types Load Data and Render

Every content route follows one of two patterns:

**Pattern A -- "Leaf content" (talk, note, video, paneltalk, tutorial):**
1. `+page.ts` calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)` which fetches the course JSON, indexes all learning objects by route, and returns the matching `Lo`.
2. `+page.svelte` wraps the content in `<Context lo={data.lo}>` (provides secondary navigation + a side panel with table-of-contents) and renders a type-specific component inside.

**Pattern B -- "Composite/structural" (course, topic):**
1. `+page.ts` calls `courseService.readCourse()` or `courseService.readTopic()`.
2. `+page.svelte` renders `<Composite composite={data.course}>` or `<Composite composite={data.topic}>` which handles panels, units, and cards.

**Pattern C -- "Lab" (special):**
1. `+page.ts` calls `courseService.readLab()` which creates a `LiveLab` instance with chapter navigation state, markdown-to-HTML conversion, and step tracking.
2. `+page.svelte` renders `<Lab lab={data.lab}>` with sidebar chapter navigation and keyboard arrow-key support.

### 3. Shared Layout Architecture

**Root layout** (`D:/code/tutors/src/routes/+layout.svelte`): Minimal -- imports `app.css`, initializes theme display, and handles auth reconnection. Renders `{@render children()}`.

**Root server layout** (`D:/code/tutors/src/routes/+layout.server.ts`): Loads auth session from `locals.auth()` and passes `loggedIn` and `user` to all pages.

**Course-reader layout** (`D:/code/tutors/src/routes/(course-reader)/+layout.svelte`): The core shared layout for all course content. It:
- Wraps everything in `<CourseShell>` (imported as `TutorsShell.svelte`)
- Starts the connect service timer
- Tracks learning events via `$effect` on page params
- Checks whitelist and logs course visits
- After navigation, auto-scrolls to `#content-panel`
- Sets the page `<title>` to the current course title

**TutorsShell** (`D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/TutorsShell.svelte`): Provides the full page scaffold:
- Sticky header with `<MainNavigator>` (AppBar with course title, search, layout menu, profile, ToC button)
- Flex main area for content
- Footer (visible only on tall screens)

### 5. End-to-End Trace: How a "Talk" is Rendered

Here is the complete flow for navigating to a URL like `/talk/my-course/topic-1/my-talk`:

**Step 1 -- Route matching and data loading:**
- SvelteKit matches `src/routes/(course-reader)/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]/+page.ts`
- `params.courseid` = `"my-course"`, `url.pathname` = `"/talk/my-course/topic-1/my-talk"`
- The loader calls `courseService.readLo("my-course", "/talk/my-course/topic-1/my-talk", fetch)`

**Step 2 -- courseService.readLo()** (file: `D:/code/tutors/src/lib/services/course/services/course.svelte.ts`, line 132):
- Calls `this.readCourse("my-course", fetch)` which:
  - Checks the course cache (`this.courses` Map)
  - If not cached, calls `determineCourseUrl()` to resolve the courseId to a URL (e.g., `my-course.netlify.app`)
  - Fetches `https://my-course.netlify.app/tutors.json`
  - Calls `decorateCourseTree()` which recursively processes all LOs: sets parent references, builds breadcrumbs, converts markdown to HTML, creates panels/units, indexes everything into `course.loIndex` and `course.topicIndex`
  - Sets `currentCourse` and `currentLo` runes
- Looks up the LO by route in `course.loIndex.get("/talk/my-course/topic-1/my-talk")`
- Sets `currentLo.value = lo`
- Returns `{ lo }` to the page

**Step 3 -- Layout rendering:**
- The `(course-reader)/+layout.svelte` wraps everything in `<TutorsShell>`:
  - `<MainNavigator>` renders at top (AppBar with course title, search, etc.)
  - `<Footer>` renders at bottom
- The layout also fires `tutorsConnectService.learningEvent(page.params)` for analytics

**Step 4 -- Page rendering** (`D:/code/tutors/src/routes/(course-reader)/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]/+page.svelte`):
```svelte
<Context lo={data.lo}>
  <TalkClient lo={data.lo} />
</Context>
```

**Step 5 -- Context.svelte** (`D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/Context.svelte`):
- Walks up `lo.parentLo` until it finds a `type === "topic"` or `type === "course"` to establish the `loContext`
- Renders `<SecondaryNavigator>` (breadcrumbs + companion icons + wall icons)
- Renders children (the TalkClient) in a flex container
- On XL screens, shows `<LoContextPanel>` sidebar on the right with an image and tree navigation for sibling content

**Step 6 -- TalkClient.svelte** (`D:/code/tutors/src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/TalkClient.svelte`):
- Checks `currentCourse.value.defaultPdfReader`
- If `"mozilla"`: dynamically imports and renders `<TalkMozilla>` (PDF.js viewer)
- Otherwise: renders `<TalkAdobe>` (Adobe PDF embed)
- The `lo.pdf` field contains the full URL to the PDF file (injected during `decorateCourseTree` via `injectCourseUrl()`)

### Summary of the Content Type Rendering Patterns

| Content Type | Route Pattern | Data Loader | Page Structure | Render Component |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **course** | `/course/[courseid]` | `readCourse()` | `<Composite>` | Panels + Units + Cards |
| **topic** | `/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readTopic()` | `<Composite>` | Panels + Units + Cards |
| **talk** | `/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLo()` | `<Context>` + child | `<TalkClient>` (PDF) |
| **paneltalk** | `/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLo()` | `<Context>` + child | `<TalkClient>` (PDF) |
| **note** | `/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLo()` | `<Context>` + child | `<Note>` (HTML from markdown) |
| **tutorial** | `/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLo()` | `<Context>` + child | `<Note>` + optional `<TalkClient>` |
| **lab** | `/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLab()` | `<Context>` + child | `<Lab>` (multi-step) or `<TalkClient>` |
| **video** | `/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `readLo()` | `<Context>` + child | `<Video>` (iframe) |
| **wall** | `/wall/[type]/[courseid]` | `readWall()` | standalone | `<Wall>` (grid of cards or videos) |

**To add a new content type (e.g., "notebook")**, the pattern would be:
1. Create route directory `src/routes/(course-reader)/notebook/[courseid]/[...loid]/`
2. Add `+page.ts` calling `courseService.readLo()` (same as talk/note/video)
3. Add `+page.svelte` wrapping a new `<Notebook>` component in `<Context>`
4. Create `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Notebook.svelte` with the rendering logic
5. Ensure the `@tutors/tutors-model-lib` model includes the "notebook" type in its Lo types and that the course JSON includes notebook LOs with appropriate routes
